absence_policy.visit motivation: Use existing string None for absent value under current convention.
absence_policy.array_sections: Use []; omit unfilled child keys and remove projected empty objects.

projection_procedure: Parse existing reference JSON. Preserve all ten parents in canonical order.
Retain only listed children at their existing parent; preserve retained values verbatim, including negation, units, punctuation and original key spelling.
Drop array items whose projection has no retained keys. Do not invent an identifier, relocate details into another field, rewrite facts or concatenate dropped fields.
Preserve order and multiplicity of surviving array items; no deduplication is applied in these metrics. Values may become identical after distinct contextual fields are removed.

Serialize compact JSON with ensure_ascii=False and separators comma/colon. Character lengths count Unicode characters, not bytes or tokenizer tokens. Scalar leaf counts include the top-level visit motivation string and repeated array values.

For future 5000-row preparation, group exact/near duplicate source cases and related case families before splitting. Do not treat duplicated targets or duplicated rows as new independent data. Do not collapse identical projected events without checking their original event context.

posthoc_saved_prediction_projection.metric_source: notebooks/03_eval_and_compare.ipynb evaluator definitions executed before score_run; original scores reproduced to 1e-12
posthoc_saved_prediction_projection.definition: Project both references and parseable saved predictions to the same field set. Leave the two invalid raw outputs invalid, receiving zero fact credit. Evaluate the existing multiset strict and greedy soft scores.
limitations: Posthoc descriptive rescore only; it is not performance of a newly trained compact-schema model.
Removing fields changes the task and denominator. Higher F1 is not evidence of improved clinical correctness or factual grounding.
Metrics ignore array event association and can miss negation/chronology errors; soft token overlap can reward contradictory wording.
Projection removes some errors from scoring rather than correcting them. Saved predictions may contain unsupported assertions in retained fields.
Original v2 validation cases are development-exposed; future training-size/schema comparisons need fresh reviewed held-out data and a same-schema baseline.

important_information_loss: Specialized history (allergies, smoking, alcohol, sexual history, nutrition, vaccination, psychological context), family/social history and other demographics are dropped unless already present in physiological context.
Admission date, duration and care center details are dropped. Surgical outcomes/reasons disappear unless already in retained details.
Separate symptom severity, evolution and aggravating/relieving behaviors are dropped; retained details can preserve some but not all assertion/temporal context.

Examination details and diagnostic-test details/condition/severity/time disappear. A negative result may survive in result, while caveats, uncertainty or canceled tests present only in details can vanish.
Treatment frequency, duration, route/supportive-care details, related condition and rationale are dropped. Dose is retained, but complete regimens cannot be reconstructed reliably from this schema.
Referral, discharge reason and follow-up plans disappear unless already in discharge summary.

No assertion/status/evidence field is added: none exists in current 57-child schema and the cap is already filled. This projection cannot establish that a symptom is present versus negated, historical, uncertain, family-related or changing over time. Review against source and annotate within retained values before accepting future samples.
Untouched original records remain the provenance source for all omitted facts. This is a compact extraction experiment, not a lossless medical record or a clinically validated summary.
